channel.title: CertPath — Modern Tech Certification Learning Platform
channel.description: Master AWS, Azure, Google Cloud, Cisco, CompTIA, and Kubernetes certifications with bite-sized lessons, flashcards, scenario labs, and timed mock exams.

item.title: AWS Certified Cloud Practitioner (CLF-C02) Complete Course
item.description: Master all 20 lessons covering Cloud Concepts, IAM Security, VPC, Compute, Storage, Databases, Well-Architected Framework, and AWS Support.

item.title: Microsoft Azure Fundamentals (AZ-900) Complete Course
item.description: Master all 20 lessons covering Azure Architecture, Virtual Machines, Blob Storage Tiers, Entra ID, Azure Monitor, Policy, and Defender for Cloud.

item.title: Google Cloud Digital Leader (CDL) Complete Course
item.description: Master all 20 lessons covering Resource Hierarchy, Compute Engine, Cloud Run, GKE, BigQuery, Pub/Sub, Vertex AI, and Security Command Center.

item.title: Kubernetes Fundamentals & CKA/CKAD Complete Course
item.description: Master all 16 lessons covering Control Plane, Pods, StatefulSets, Services, Ingress, NetworkPolicies, Helm, and Cluster Diagnostics.

item.title: Cisco Certified Network Associate (CCNA 200-301) Complete Course
item.description: Master all 16 lessons covering OSI 7 layers, IPv4/IPv6 VLSM subnetting, VLANs, OSPF routing, Switch Security, Wireless WLC, and SDN Automation.

item.title: CompTIA IT Fundamentals (ITF+) & A+ Complete Course
item.description: Master all 16 lessons covering Hardware, NVMe & RAID, CLI Administration, Wi-Fi 6, Cybersecurity MFA, SQL, and 6-step Troubleshooting.
